news.title: Bank Pekao to support Polish companies in foreign markets, joins forces with Raiffeisen Bank International
news.snippet: Bank Pekao S.A. and Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) have signed a cooperation agreement aimed at supporting clients expanding across European markets.
